name: Voxel Space Setup
definition: Computes the voxel space bounding box and transformation matrices to map world coordinates to voxel grid indices, including padding and cube voxel normalization.
summary: Voxel Space Setup computes transformation matrices to map world coordinates to a Cartesian voxel grid, differing from spherical setups by using Cartesian coordinates and from incremental back-rotation by performing static initialization.
